description.en: Original Yochelcionella-inspired preserved shell only: a tall laterally compressed curved cap with an obliquely rising subapical tube, modeled as one continuous wall with a real open tube mouth and shell aperture. No borrowed Clavagella/Haplophrentis geometry, soft body, foot or respiratory-mechanism claim. Nominal22mm cap/tube span, quiet color and economical growth relief are artistic; viewer magnification is separate from real source units.
